okuma.giris: In Reading World your child reads short stories starring a hero of their own choice and answers comprehension questions at the end of each one. On this page you can see their reading habit and which kinds of questions may need support, and choose the values you want to see first in story suggestions.

premium.baslik: The detailed summary opens with premium
premium.metin: Accuracy by question type, theme and value distribution, goal progress and difficulty trend appear with a premium membership or during the trial. Reading and answering questions are available on the free plan (the daily story count may be limited); choosing value priorities is always open.

dogruluk.aciklama: Which kinds of comprehension questions does your child find easy, and which might need support?
dogruluk.yetersiz: Not enough questions answered yet (at least 3 needed)
dogruluk.not: These rates do not label your child; they show which type of question is worth talking through together.

hedefler.aciklama: Reading a story does not mean a goal is learned. "Recalled" and "Used in a new context" only appear after correct answers on later days.
hedefler.bos: No goals are being tracked yet.

zorluk.aciklama: Average reading and concept difficulty of stories read each week (1 easy, 5 hard).
zorluk.bos: No data for the difficulty trend yet.

sure.not: For information only; it is not an indicator of learning.

puan.yetersiz: Not enough votes yet (at least 3 needed).

nasil.oran: Accuracy = correct answers / questions answered. Unanswered questions count as incorrect.
nasil.minN: If a question type has fewer than 3 questions, or the rating has fewer than 3 votes, no rate is shown. This does not mean "low"; it only means there is not enough data yet.
nasil.ogrenme: Learning is indicated by question accuracy and goal progress. XP and reading time are not used as learning measures.
nasil.zaman: The date range comes from the period selected above; the day boundary uses Istanbul time.
nasil.cinsiyet: No statistic is broken down by gender, and children are never compared with each other.

degerler.aciklama: Choose the Maarif values you want to see first in story suggestions (up to 5).
degerler.yasakDegil: This is not a restriction, just a suggestion priority: stories matching your chosen values are shown first, and other stories stay available.
degerler.kapali: Reading World is not yet open for this account. You can choose value priorities here once it is.

degerler.catiNot: The three values labelled "umbrella" (justice, respect, responsibility) are the umbrella values of the Maarif model that run through all the others.
degerler.kaydedildi: Saved. These values will be shown first in story suggestions.
